title: Acquire covariance actions for a conditional Gaussian value circuit
statement: For acquired x and known H_x(W)=sum_(i=1)^q c_i g(b_i(x)+sum_(l=1)^r beta_il W_l),a four-original-value fresh transpose/forward heat word has conditional mean Cov(H_x(W))v and pathwise norm<=Bword^2||v||,Bword=L sum_i|c_i|||beta_i||. Same conditional time/center data and fresh action seeds are essential.

requires: Conservative raw globally L-Lipschitz g and scalar-block Gaussian circuit
Centers,coefficients and x available before fresh seeds;preparation charged
Nonzero stochastic blocks,or separate trivial zero-covariance handling
provides: Two-value forward/transpose Clark-matrix actions through known beta blocks
Gaussian-input squared action error<=Bword^4d,or Bword^4d/M after M fresh words
Uniform conditional laws may retain prior x and compose with summed errors
assumptions: Arbitrary anisotropic source covariance is outside the isotropic heat-action contract
Proved B0 may control ideal-law/Poincare terms;Bword controls random-action noise
Optional affine subtraction pays changed norm,transpose and arithmetic certificates
costs: 4 original calls per action;literal full sampler q(n+1)+4M
Direct action work/storage O(rd+q) beyond O(qd+qr) data;value evaluation costs q calls and O(qrd+qd) work
Captured code tests conditional ACTION;no assembled conditional-sampler wrapper/test captured
contract.units: Conditional covariance action and original whole-vector queries
contract.obstruction: Explicit circuit interface,not every nonlinear current-law program or recursive closure.

evidence.range_scope: Four-value covariance/conditional-circuit actions,rational source replicas,weak fourth-order full-law lemma and actual capped sampler;no recursive closure.

evidence.quote: No core mathematical blocker was found.
evidence.range_scope: Completed same-informed-peer static mathematical/acquisition reconstruction of the exact five proof hashes and both code files;missing historical audits/diagnostics remain unverified.

body: Scalar-block structure and fresh seeds justify composition. Ideal circuit cancellation does not make Bword small automatically.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
